## Case study: Guild of Guardians

- URL: https://bramha.work/work/guild-of-guardians
- Client: Immutable
- Role: Feature Owner & Lead UX Designer
- Timeline: ~6 months
- Outcomes: +25% D7 retention, +12% D7 LTV on a live mobile RPG
- Themes: data analysis, retention, live ops, AFK rewards, monetization, personas, A/B surveys

## Case study: Rocksmith+

- URL: https://bramha.work/work/rocksmith
- Client: Ubisoft
- Role: UX Lead for Mobile & Multi-platform Interactions
- Timeline: ~2 years
- Outcomes: one UI system across 5 platforms (PC, console, mobile)
- Themes: accessibility, 3D/2D UI coordination, input systems, nested scroll, user research
